tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Cisco ASR 920-24SZ-IM Router | High-Performance Metro Ethernet Router

Advanced, Scalable & Reliable Routing for Metro Networks
The Cisco ASR 920-24SZ-IM Router is a high-performance Metro Ethernet router designed to deliver exceptional scalability, resilience, and flexibility. With 24 GE SFP ports, 4 x 10G SFP+ ports, and an optional IM card slot, this router ensures seamless connectivity and high-speed data transfer for service providers, enterprises, and metro networks.

High-Speed Throughput – 64 Gbps for ultra-fast data processing
Advanced Metro IP Access – 10G Full License for enhanced networking
Carrier-Grade Redundancy – Dual AC 100V~240V (Hot Swap) Power Supplies
Superior Connectivity – 24 x 1GE SFP & 4 x 10G SFP+ Ports
Flexible & Scalable Design – Supports optional IM cards
Optimized Airflow – Front-to-back & side-to-back cooling for efficiency

Key Features & Benefits

  • High-Performance Routing – Throughput of 64 Gbps for superior performance
  • Full 10G License – Advanced Metro IP Access for seamless operations
  • Redundant Power Supply – Dual AC (100V~240V, 50/60Hz) Hot-Swap Power Units
  • Enhanced Connectivity – 24 x 1GE SFP, 4 x 10G SFP+ Ports, IM Card Slot
  • Compact Rack Design – 1.5U form factor for space-saving installation
  • Optimized Cooling – Front-to-back & side-to-back airflow for reliability
  • Power-Efficient – Max system power consumption of just 180W

Technical Specifications

Performance & Connectivity
Ports:
  • 24 x 1GE SFP Ports
  • 4 x 10G SFP+ Ports
  • IM Card Slot (Optional)
  • Throughput: 64 Gbps
  • Rack Unit: 1.5U

Power & Environmental

  • Power Supply: 2 x AC (100V-240V, 50/60Hz, Hot-Swap, Redundant)
  • Max Power Consumption: 180W
  • System Power Capacity: 250W Maximum

Cooling & Airflow
Optimized Airflow: Front-to-back & Side-to-back ventilation

Security & Networking
Advanced Metro IP Access License – Full 10G License Included

What’s in the Box?

  • Cisco ASR 920-24SZ-IM Router
  • 2 x AC Hot-Swap Power Supplies
  • Mounting Brackets & Accessories
  • User Manual & Setup Guide

Ideal Use Cases

  • Metro Ethernet Networks – Carrier-grade resilient networking
  • Service Providers & ISPs – Reliable high-speed data transmission
  • Enterprises & Data Centers – Scalable connectivity solutions
  • Smart City Infrastructure – Secure & flexible IP networking
  • Industrial & Government Networks – Mission-critical applications

Why Choose the Cisco ASR 920-24SZ-IM Router?

  • High-Performance Metro Routing – 64 Gbps throughput for smooth operations
  • Full 10G Advanced Metro IP Access License – No extra licensing required
  • Redundant Power Supply for Reliability – Hot-swappable dual AC PSU
  • Compact & Efficient – 1.5U rack-mounted design with optimized airflow
  • Cisco’s Trusted Performance – Backed by a 1-Year Warranty
